description: Hallway view of the Abiquiu house;   white textured adobe wall with door, light switch and a large dark stucco stone step in front of doorway with a closed door; Hanging on the white door is a Bode's General Merchandise calendar picturing a white horse and young man wearing a  mariachi-like costume and an elaborate embellished sombrero. The calendar has a clothespin  clipped to bottom ( see M.W. caption) and there is a basket sitting to the left of the door on what appears to be a banco. Light streaming from the right of the picture plane illuminates the shadows of the hallway.
title: The Indian Room
